discovery_context.new_information: Previous authenticated watch documented one young man killed, several wounded, and one wounded child per Safa. A WAFA Arabic page explicitly labeled updated now reports two killed (one young man, one child) plus others injured at the same al-Ja'farawi location.
discovery_context.scope: Same incident, updated fatality toll; do not double-count as a second separate attack.
discovery_context.timing: Page's displayed 11:50 Palestine local publication time predates this observation interval. No independently verified update timestamp was available. This is a late-recalled change in previously recorded casualty detail, not evidence another person died during 04:50–05:45 PST.
discovery_context.corroboration: The earlier Safa account described one death and a wounded child; separate confirmation of the second death was not found in 12 bounded searches. Child identity and clinical outcome unverified.
discovery_context.limitations: Updated label has no revision history; a later modification or original existence of the second fatality cannot be timed. Do not assume the previously reported injured child is the reported deceased child.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall only; production remains authoritative.

17 November Gaza early incursion, al-Bureij injury and 15 November near-Rafah fuel convoy incident: prior heartbeats already captured.
Historical Reuters November 11-12 Nasser Hospital strike, older UN coverage, retrospective or unverifiable items: excluded.
Projected $300m World Bank grant: anticipated financing, not confirmed actual Gaza service delivery or access change.
limitations: WHO Eastern Mediterranean regional index returned HTTP 502; recurring known source restriction. WHO global and OCHA official sources accessible, so watch completed DEGRADED rather than FAILED.
WFP news index returned HTTP 403 and UN News index robots denial; other relevant sources accessible.

The updated WAFA Arabic fatality toll was newly recovered against authenticated prior ledger but its actual edit timestamp is unknown and may precede the search window; mark follow-up rather than new incident.
The supplemental coverage is bounded to 12 targeted searches plus direct first-party index/page checks; search-index lag and missing corroboration limit completeness.
No schedule changes, approvals, publication, production writes, branch changes outside ops/watch-ledger, or disabling actions.
coverage_notes.overall: One previously uncaptured material follow-up: updated civilian death toll for already reported al-Ja'farawi gunfire, now two including a child. Known source restrictions persist; useful official coverage obtained. Exactly one heartbeat requested.
